messages:
mara: Heads-up — customer (SUP-3421) reports huge cross-region latency. They sent x-rw-region: eu-west-1 but we see traffic hitting us-east. They see 1.8s p50 -> app is complaining.

nishant: @mara can you paste a correlation id or sample request?

mara: corr=7a9c2f4b. Sample from customer:
```
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -H 'x-rw-region: eu-west-1' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```

tony: looking at gateway logs for request_id=7a9c2f4b: upstream_host=us-east-inference-01, x-forwarded-region=us-east-1, original_region_header=eu-west-1

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: envoy-header-rewrite-v2 rolled at 2025-06-12T09:12Z (canary: 10%) :gear:

nishant: that's likely the envoy L7 header rewrite change. I think the rewrite rule is clobbering x-rw-region on Host wildcard match and triggering our fallback routing. Could be mismatch between header vs cookie precedence.

mara: customer also saw intermittent 401s and a billing spike due to retries — they retried on timeouts and got charged more. They included a heap of 429s in logs.

tonys: quick log snippet:
```
2025-06-12T09:15:34Z INFO request_id=7a9c2f4b route=generate matched_policy=fallback-to-default region_header=eu-west-1 rewritten_region=us-east-1 upstream_latency=800ms
```

nishant: repro plan: send 100 concurrent requests with x-rw-region=eu-west-1 + sticky cookie set to eu-west-1 and observe routing. Early test: ~28% route to us-east. I can reproduce locally with envoy-filter v2.

mara: can we hotfix? Customer is getting noisy and billing team flagged potential chargeback.

tonys: options: 1) rollback envoy-header-rewrite-v2 2) change header_operation to APPEND instead of REPLACE for x-rw-region 3) tighten match rule so host wildcard doesn't rewrite region header. I prefer canary rollback to be safe.

nishant: starting canary rollback now. Command: `kubectl apply -f envoy-header-rewrite-rollback-canary.yaml --namespace=gateway`

ops-bot: ops-bot: started canary rollback job at 2025-06-12T09:43:21Z

mara: informed customer and created incident INC-853, attached initial logs and billing spike numbers.

tonys: after canary rollback (10->50->100%) observation: region routing stabilized for new requests. Still seeing some in-flight 401s and retries from earlier. Recommend invalidating session KV for affected customer to clear sticky cookies.

nishant: adding repro steps to SUP-3421 and ticket INC-853. Root cause: envoy header_rewrite with overly-broad host match replaced x-rw-region header, causing the smart router to fall back to default region (us-east). Will include config diff and candidate fix (append/preserve).

mara: nice work. Please add timeline and metric charts (latency by region, token usage) to the postmortem. I'll follow up with billing and the customer ops contact. :thumbsup:

nishant: postmortem TODO: include exact envoy filter snippet, canary timestamps, correlation ids, and a script to reproduce (will attach).

mara: closing the support escalation after we confirm billing adjustments and postmortem.
